measurementProposal.referenceDeviceAcceptance: Owner must accept each actual environment identity before qualification. Emulator is not physical Android reference hardware.
measurementProposal.sampling: Release builds. 30 cold starts separate; 200 warmup edits then 1000 measured edits per workload and 20 fixed seeds. Retain all samples, p50/p95/p99/max and allocations; never drop failures/outliers silently.
measurementProposal.G1: Counters must show zero whole-document serialization/flattening on ordinary local edits. Compare 1K/100K/1M UTF16 units at fixed edit locality; local traversal delta <=2 tree heights + touched leaves. Record actual data structure deviations, not an invented logarithmic pass.
measurementProposal.G7: 20 warmup open/edit/close cycles, then 100 measured cycles; sample retained post-GC heap every 5 cycles (20 samples). Proposed upper 95% CI of linear growth <=64KiB/cycle AND final-20-cycle median growth <=5% of post-warmup baseline. Report renderer/media separately and live resource/reference counts; no timing-based claim of power-loss durability.
measurementProposal.G8: Preserve sealed numeric targets: core edit p95<=2ms/p99<=5ms; ordinary paragraph layout p95<=8ms; accepted-to-presented frame p95<=33ms; standard scroll p95<=16.7ms; core+bounded history<=128MiB. 100K-unit paragraph p95<=100ms remains high-risk/unmet. Independent clocks/counters and exact fonts required.
